statement: The new rank rule no longer matches the most common form, rank + "." + space. `(?:\.|\s)` consumes the dot and the closing `\b` then fails before the space, so `CAPT. X`, `COL. X`, `BRIG. X`, `HAV. X` and `MAJ. GEN. X` are unflagged unless another term matches. 417 titles flagged at e2ec65c4 lost their flag and 80 gained one. With `(?:\.\s*|\s)` in place of `(?:\.|\s)` the same rule flags 8,077; the committed rule flags 7,700, so 377 titles are missed, 95 of them naming Union of India or UOI. The reported figure 7,700 is therefore too low, and the new test passes because it has no dot-plus-space case. The intended exclusions (inspector, manager, divisional, secy) work.
requested_action: Change the separator to `(?:\.\s*|\s)`, add `CAPT. X v UOI` and `MAJ. GEN. X v UOI` to the test, regenerate (expected 8,077 candidates)
